# Execution quality: session of 11 Nov 2026
Variables: `@day` (TICK string; change it to `'$yesterday'` to make the dashboard roll forward each day), `@compare_days` (the day being reviewed plus the day before it), `@gbp` / `@eur` (USD conversion; 11 Nov averages from FX_FEED).

**Markout convention:** signed by side, in bps of the fill price, against the same venue's mid. A positive number means the market moved in our favour. *Drift-neutral* means the average of the buy-side and sell-side markouts, so the day's trend cancels out. Strips (Q/Sum/Win/Cal) are excluded where noted, because their screen quotes are often stale and make a poor benchmark.

**Headline:** only one book/curve combination is being picked off: **EU_GAS resting orders in ICE NBP months**. They lose about 2 bps within 60 s (about −$17k on 11 Nov), and the same pattern shows on 10 Nov. Every other book/curve keeps its spread or better. The lower panels show the items that look bad but are not execution problems.

SELECT h.offset/1_000_000_000 AS horizon_sec, t.venue || CASE WHEN t.passive THEN ' passive' ELSE ' aggressive' END AS segment,
 avg(CASE WHEN t.qty>0 THEN (q.bid+q.ask)/2 - t.px ELSE t.px - (q.bid+q.ask)/2 END / t.px * 10000) AS markout_bps
FROM energy_fills t HORIZON JOIN energy_quotes q ON (t.symbol = q.symbol AND t.venue = q.source)
LIST (-60s, -10s, 0, 1s, 10s, 30s, 60s, 120s, 300s) AS h
WHERE t.ts IN @day
ORDER BY segment, horizon_sec
cells.name: Markout curve by venue & aggressor (bps, vs venue mid)

cells.value:
WITH m AS (
  SELECT t.curve, t.qty > 0 AS is_buy, h.offset/1_000_000_000 AS horizon_sec,
    avg(CASE WHEN t.qty>0 THEN (q.bid+q.ask)/2 - t.px ELSE t.px - (q.bid+q.ask)/2 END / t.px * 10000) AS mk
  FROM energy_fills t HORIZON JOIN energy_quotes q ON (t.symbol = q.symbol AND t.venue = q.source)
  LIST (0, 1s, 10s, 30s, 60s, 120s, 300s) AS h
  WHERE t.ts IN @day AND t.passive AND NOT t.symbol ~ '_(Q[1-4]|Sum|Win|Cal)-'
)
SELECT horizon_sec, curve, avg(mk) AS drift_neutral_bps FROM m GROUP BY horizon_sec, curve ORDER BY curve, horizon_sec
cells.name: Passive fills: drift-neutral markout by curve (bps)

cells.value:
WITH m AS (
  SELECT t.book, t.curve, t.qty > 0 AS is_buy, h.offset/1_000_000_000 AS horizon_sec, count() AS n,
    avg(CASE WHEN t.qty>0 THEN (q.bid+q.ask)/2 - t.px ELSE t.px - (q.bid+q.ask)/2 END / t.px * 10000) AS mk,
    avg((q.ask-q.bid)/((q.ask+q.bid)/2)*10000)/2 AS hsb
  FROM energy_fills t HORIZON JOIN energy_quotes q ON (t.symbol = q.symbol AND t.venue = q.source)
  LIST (0, 60s, 300s) AS h
  WHERE t.ts IN @day AND t.passive AND NOT t.symbol ~ '_(Q[1-4]|Sum|Win|Cal)-'
)
SELECT book, curve, sum(CASE WHEN horizon_sec = 0 THEN n END) AS fills,
  avg(CASE WHEN horizon_sec = 0 THEN hsb END) AS half_spread_bps,
  avg(CASE WHEN horizon_sec = 0 THEN mk END) AS at_fill_bps,
  avg(CASE WHEN horizon_sec = 60 THEN mk END) AS mk_60s_bps,
  avg(CASE WHEN horizon_sec = 300 THEN mk END) AS mk_5m_bps
FROM m GROUP BY book, curve ORDER BY mk_60s_bps
cells.name: Passive fills by book × curve (drift-neutral bps, strips excluded)

cells.value:
WITH m AS (
  SELECT timestamp_floor('d', t.ts) AS trade_day, t.book, t.qty > 0 AS is_buy, h.offset/1_000_000_000 AS horizon_sec,
    count() AS n, sum(abs(t.qty)) AS therms,
    avg(CASE WHEN t.qty>0 THEN (q.bid+q.ask)/2 - t.px ELSE t.px - (q.bid+q.ask)/2 END / t.px * 10000) AS mk,
    sum(CASE WHEN t.qty>0 THEN (q.bid+q.ask)/2 - t.px ELSE t.px - (q.bid+q.ask)/2 END * abs(t.qty) * 0.01 * @gbp) AS pnl
  FROM energy_fills t HORIZON JOIN energy_quotes q ON (t.symbol = q.symbol AND t.venue = q.source)
  LIST (0, 60s, 300s) AS h
  WHERE t.ts IN @compare_days AND t.passive AND t.curve = 'NBP' AND NOT t.symbol ~ '_(Q[1-4]|Sum|Win|Cal)-'
)
SELECT trade_day, book,
  sum(CASE WHEN horizon_sec = 0 THEN n END) AS fills,
  sum(CASE WHEN horizon_sec = 0 THEN therms END) AS therms,
  avg(CASE WHEN horizon_sec = 0 THEN mk END) AS at_fill_bps,
  avg(CASE WHEN horizon_sec = 60 THEN mk END) AS mk_60s_bps,
  avg(CASE WHEN horizon_sec = 300 THEN mk END) AS mk_5m_bps,
  sum(CASE WHEN horizon_sec = 60 THEN pnl END) AS pnl_60s_usd,
  sum(CASE WHEN horizon_sec = 300 THEN pnl END) AS pnl_5m_usd
FROM m GROUP BY trade_day, book ORDER BY book, trade_day
cells.name: NBP passive months by book, day vs prior day (USD)

WITH m AS (
  SELECT t.trader, t.book, t.qty > 0 AS is_buy, h.offset/1_000_000_000 AS horizon_sec, count() AS n,
    avg(CASE WHEN t.qty>0 THEN (q.bid+q.ask)/2 - t.px ELSE t.px - (q.bid+q.ask)/2 END / t.px * 10000) AS mk,
    sum(CASE WHEN t.qty>0 THEN (q.bid+q.ask)/2 - t.px ELSE t.px - (q.bid+q.ask)/2 END * abs(t.qty) * 0.01 * @gbp) AS pnl
  FROM energy_fills t HORIZON JOIN energy_quotes q ON (t.symbol = q.symbol AND t.venue = q.source)
  LIST (0, 60s, 300s) AS h
  WHERE t.ts IN @day AND t.passive AND t.curve = 'NBP' AND NOT t.symbol ~ '_(Q[1-4]|Sum|Win|Cal)-'
)
SELECT trader, book, sum(CASE WHEN horizon_sec = 0 THEN n END) AS fills,
  avg(CASE WHEN horizon_sec = 0 THEN mk END) AS at_fill_bps,
  avg(CASE WHEN horizon_sec = 60 THEN mk END) AS mk_60s_bps,
  avg(CASE WHEN horizon_sec = 300 THEN mk END) AS mk_5m_bps,
  sum(CASE WHEN horizon_sec = 60 THEN pnl END) AS pnl_60s_usd
FROM m GROUP BY trader, book ORDER BY pnl_60s_usd
cells.name: NBP passive months by trader (USD)

WITH m AS (
  SELECT t.venue, t.curve, t.passive, h.offset/1_000_000_000 AS horizon_sec, count() AS n,
    sum(CASE WHEN t.qty>0 THEN (q.bid+q.ask)/2 - t.px ELSE t.px - (q.bid+q.ask)/2 END * abs(t.qty) *
      CASE WHEN t.curve = 'NBP' THEN 0.01 * @gbp WHEN t.curve IN ('UKPWR','UKA') THEN @gbp WHEN t.curve IN ('TTF','EUA') THEN @eur ELSE 1.0 END) AS pnl
  FROM energy_fills t HORIZON JOIN energy_quotes q ON (t.symbol = q.symbol AND t.venue = q.source)
  LIST (0, 60s, 300s) AS h
  WHERE t.ts IN @day
)
SELECT venue, curve, passive, sum(CASE WHEN horizon_sec = 0 THEN n END) AS fills,
  sum(CASE WHEN horizon_sec = 0 THEN pnl END) AS spread_pnl_usd,
  sum(CASE WHEN horizon_sec = 60 THEN pnl END) AS pnl_60s_usd,
  sum(CASE WHEN horizon_sec = 300 THEN pnl END) AS pnl_5m_usd
FROM m GROUP BY venue, curve, passive ORDER BY pnl_60s_usd
cells.name: Markout P&L by venue × curve × aggressor (USD)

## Looks wrong, but isn't an execution-quality problem
- **EEX feed outage 08:45–08:48 UTC**: zero quotes on every EEX contract for 3 minutes. No EEX fills landed in the gap. This is a market-data issue.
- **Stale strip quotes**: fills in Q/Sum/Win strips show markouts of ±10–30 bps at the moment of the fill, because the ICE / ICE_ENDEX strip quote was 20 s to 15 min old. The benchmark is broken here; the fills are not.
- **Late OTC/broker booking**: broker trades are booked about 1–1.5 h after execution on average, and OTC trades about 3–7 h (up to 24 h). Intraday position and P&L views built on `booked_ts` (e.g. `energy_book_restated`) understate the book.
- **EEX routing**: aggressive EEX fills pay roughly twice the half-spread available on the primary venue. This is a routing cost on small volume, not adverse selection.
cells.name: Not execution problems

WITH c AS (SELECT ts, source, count() AS n FROM energy_quotes WHERE ts IN @day SAMPLE BY 1m FILL(0)),
w AS (SELECT ts, source, n, avg(n) OVER (PARTITION BY source ORDER BY ts ROWS BETWEEN 30 PRECEDING AND 1 PRECEDING) AS baseline FROM c)
SELECT ts AS minute, source, n AS quotes, round(baseline) AS normal_quotes FROM w WHERE n < 0.05 * baseline ORDER BY minute
cells.name: Quote feed outages (minutes with <5% of normal quote rate)

SELECT t.ts, t.symbol, t.venue, t.passive, t.trader, t.qty, t.px, q.bid, q.ask, (t.ts - q.ts) / 1e9 AS quote_age_s,
  CASE WHEN t.qty>0 THEN (q.bid+q.ask)/2 - t.px ELSE t.px - (q.bid+q.ask)/2 END / t.px * 10000 AS at_fill_bps
FROM energy_fills t ASOF JOIN energy_quotes q ON (t.symbol = q.symbol AND t.venue = q.source)
WHERE t.ts IN @day AND (t.ts - q.ts) > 30_000_000_000
ORDER BY quote_age_s DESC
cells.name: Fills benchmarked against a stale quote (>30 s old)

cells.value:
SELECT channel, count() AS trades, avg((booked_ts - trade_ts) / 1e6) / 60 AS avg_delay_min,
  max((booked_ts - trade_ts) / 1e6) / 60 AS max_delay_min,
  sum(CASE WHEN timestamp_floor('d', booked_ts) > timestamp_floor('d', trade_ts) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS booked_next_day
FROM energy_trade_events WHERE version = 1 AND trade_ts IN @day GROUP BY channel ORDER BY avg_delay_min DESC
cells.name: Booking delay by channel (trade time → booked time)

cells.value:
WITH f AS (SELECT ts, symbol, curve, qty, px, passive, CASE WHEN curve = 'UKPWR' THEN 'ICE' ELSE 'ICE_ENDEX' END AS src FROM energy_fills WHERE venue = 'EEX' AND ts IN @day)
SELECT f.curve, f.passive, count() AS fills,
 avg(CASE WHEN f.qty>0 THEN (q.bid+q.ask)/2 - f.px ELSE f.px - (q.bid+q.ask)/2 END / f.px * 10000) AS at_fill_vs_primary_bps,
 avg((q.ask-q.bid)/((q.ask+q.bid)/2)*10000)/2 AS primary_half_spread_bps
FROM f HORIZON JOIN energy_quotes q ON (f.symbol = q.symbol AND f.src = q.source)
LIST (0) AS h ORDER BY f.curve, f.passive
cells.name: EEX fills measured against the primary venue (bps)

cells.value:
WITH b AS ((SELECT trade_ts, symbol, curve, qty, px, channel, counterparty,
   CASE WHEN curve IN ('TTF','EUA') THEN 'ICE_ENDEX' WHEN curve = 'WTI' THEN 'CME' ELSE 'ICE' END AS src
  FROM energy_trade_events WHERE version = 1 AND channel != 'EXCH' AND trade_ts IN @day ORDER BY trade_ts) timestamp(trade_ts)),
m AS (SELECT b.counterparty, h.offset/60_000_000 AS horizon_min, count() AS n,
  avg(CASE WHEN b.qty>0 THEN (q.bid+q.ask)/2 - b.px ELSE b.px - (q.bid+q.ask)/2 END / b.px * 10000) AS mk,
  stddev_samp(CASE WHEN b.qty>0 THEN (q.bid+q.ask)/2 - b.px ELSE b.px - (q.bid+q.ask)/2 END / b.px * 10000) AS sd
 FROM b HORIZON JOIN energy_quotes q ON (b.symbol = q.symbol AND b.src = q.source)
 LIST (0, 5m, 30m) AS h)
SELECT counterparty, sum(CASE WHEN horizon_min = 0 THEN n END) AS trades,
  avg(CASE WHEN horizon_min = 0 THEN mk END) AS at_trade_bps,
  avg(CASE WHEN horizon_min = 5 THEN mk END) AS mk_5m_bps,
  avg(CASE WHEN horizon_min = 30 THEN mk END) AS mk_30m_bps,
  avg(CASE WHEN horizon_min = 30 THEN mk / (sd / sqrt(n)) END) AS t_30m
FROM m GROUP BY counterparty ORDER BY mk_30m_bps
cells.name: Broker/OTC counterparties: markout vs primary venue mid (bps, small samples, check t)
